bundle.shortDescription: Beginner-friendly AI image generation frontend for ComfyUI
bundle.longDescription: FalafelUI is a modern desktop frontend that hides ComfyUI's node-graph complexity behind a clean, intuitive interface. Features text-to-image, image-to-image, inpainting, built-in upscaling, and one-click setup.
